Nine independent PostgreSQL statements return SQLSTATE 42501 in both sync and async: CREATE TABLE, ADD COLUMN, CREATE INDEX, TRUNCATE, DROP TABLE, table OWNER TO runtime, schema OWNER TO runtime, DROP SCHEMA, SET ROLE fixture owner
